item.title: CoreWeave’s debt hits $35bn: What it means for the neocloud refinancing wall
item.summary: CoreWeave's Q2 results confirm the scale of the debt underpinning the GPU cloud sector, and sharpen a question due behind closed doors at next month's Metro Connect Fall x Datacloud USA. The post CoreWeave’s debt hits $35bn: What it means for the neocloud refinancing wall appeared first on Capacity .
